question: What is the meaning of gross floor area in relation to building infromation?
description: Gross floor area refers to the total floor area of a building, including all spaces such as rooms, corridors, and other enclosed areas. It is a key metric in building information modeling (BIM) and is used to determine the overall size and layout of a building.
